items.title: 你的 Coding Agent 有多大价值，取决于它对你的数据了解多少 | 技术实践
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，Coding Agent 做数据工作时的常见问题不是幻觉，而是缺少环境上下文：不了解生产表、受治理 Schema、RBAC 或 Snowflake 特有对象，生成的代码语法正确但仍需人工改。手工喂 Schema 与示例本质是集成工作，脱敏、行级访问控制等治理对 Agent 几乎不可见。
items.summary_en: The piece argues that coding agents fail at data work less from hallucination and more from missing context: they don't know production tables, governed schemas, RBAC, or Snowflake-specific constructs, so they produce syntactically valid code that still needs rework. Hand-feeding schemas via prompts is essentially integration work disguised as AI, and governance layers like masking and row-level security are invisible to agents running outside the platform. Data engineers should weigh how much environment context an agent actually gets.

items.summary_en: apipeek wraps mitmproxy into a one-click packet capture tool: it starts an HTTP/HTTPS proxy, embeds the mitmweb UI for live request/response inspection, and logs each request as one JSONL line in requests.jsonl. It also supports domain filtering and HAR export, ships a Windows portable build (unzip and run), and can be installed via pip install -e . for further development. Useful for debugging, API integration testing, and authorized traffic analysis.

items.summary_zh: Meta AI Research 开源 300 亿参数模型 Muse Glimmer，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，专为本地智能体、工具调用、编码和 LLM 评估设计。借助动态量化与 DFlash 推测解码，模型占用约 17-20GB，在 M4/M5 Max、RTX 5090 上生成速度最高提升 3.1 倍；1.8B 参数感知编码器支持交错图文输入，基准测试优于 Gemma 4 31B 和 Qwen 3.6 27B。
items.summary_en: Meta AI Research open-sourced Muse Glimmer, a 30B-parameter model under Apache 2.0, designed for always-on local workflows such as autonomous agents, complex tool use, local coding, and LLM-as-judge evaluation. Dynamic quantization shrinks memory to roughly 17–20GB, and DFlash speculative decoding boosts throughput up to 3.1x on M4/M5 Max and RTX 5090. A dedicated 1.8B perception encoder handles interleaved multimodal inputs, and benchmarks show stronger multi-step tool-call reliability than Gemma 4 31B and Qwen 3.6 27B.

items.title: Rust 再下一城：Astro 7 重写编译器与 Markdown 流水线
items.summary_zh: Astro 7 聚焦构建性能：编译器用 Rust 重写，Markdown/MDX 迁移到新的 Rust 流水线，并基于 Vite 8 与 Rolldown；官方测试显示构建提速 15%~61%。新编译器更严格，Markdown 改走自研 Sätteri 处理器，还带来 Hono 兼容入口与稳定路由缓存；HN 用户对依赖数减少和放弃 unified 反应不一。
items.summary_en: Astro 7 focuses on build performance: the .astro compiler is rewritten in Rust, Markdown/MDX processing moves to a Rust pipeline, and the framework runs on Vite 8 with Rolldown; official benchmarks show 15%–61% faster builds, with astro.build dropping from 62.70s to 24.24s. The stricter compiler now errors on unclosed tags, Markdown goes through the new Sätteri processor, and there are Hono-compatible entry points, stable route caching, and experimental CDN providers. Hacker News reaction is mixed, with praise for fewer dependencies and criticism of the Markdown/unified switch.

items.summary_en: DeepSeek launched an experimental multimodal model, deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp, marking its first official API support for image understanding. Images are converted to tokens — up to 384 per image — and billed at the same rate as V4-Flash. Compared with V4-Flash-0731, most benchmarks improved (e.g., +5.6 on Toolathlon, +4.9 on DeepSWE), bringing text-agent performance close to Opus 4.8. API calls support Chat Completions, Messages, and Responses, with base64, URL, or Files API image input.

items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

items.description: 我看着老板的脸色由白转红，又有点儿紫，最后有点儿黑，没说一句话。沉默良久以后老板开口说：小X啊，这个事儿公司需要开会讨论一下，你把材料留下先回去吧。走出办公室的一刻，我看着老板拿起那份账单...
items.summary_zh: 文章讲述了一位程序员因公司使用Kimi K3 API成本过高，被老板要求研究本地化部署方案。他精心计算后，发现搭建一套能够承载同等性能的本地系统其实需要三千万人民币，而不是老板想象的低成本。当他把账单放在桌上，老板的脸色从白转红、再转紫最后变黑，沉默良久后让员工先回去等开会讨论。这个故事生动揭示了AI大模型商用部署的现实困境：看似便宜的API背后隐藏着高昂的调用成本，而自建基础设施的门槛更是高得惊人。
items.summary_en: This story recounts a programmer who was asked by his boss to explore local deployment of Kimi K3 after the API costs proved too expensive. After careful calculation, he discovered that building an on-premise system matching the same performance would actually cost 30 million yuan—far more than the boss expected. When he presented the bill, the boss's face turned from white to red, then purplish, and finally black; after a long silence, he told the employee to leave the documents and wait for a meeting. The tale vividly illustrates the harsh reality of deploying large AI models commercially: low API prices hide huge cumulative costs, while self-hosting demands astronomical investment.

items.summary_en: Deepfakes Faceswap is an open-source deepfake software that makes face swapping and video synthesis accessible to everyone. items.title: DeepSeek 居然会对用户说「我去吃饭了」「我去睡了」，为啥会出现这样的现象？
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 对用户说出"我去吃饭了""我去睡了"，是因为模型在模拟人类社交惯例，而不是真的具备生理状态。这类拟人化输出通常由用户设定的人设、上下文中的角色扮演或网络语料中的高频表达触发，说明大模型的自我认知并不稳定。它提醒开发者，提示词中的角色设定会显著影响模型的回复边界。
items.summary_en: DeepSeek responding "I'm going to eat" or "I'm going to sleep" is a sign of the model mimicking human conversational routines, not actual awareness. These anthropomorphic replies occur when user-set personas, roleplay context, or chat-heavy training data steer the model. It reveals how unstable LLM self-identity can be and reminds developers that system prompts heavily shape output boundaries.
